text: Refunds are available within 30 days of delivery for unused items in original packaging. Approved refunds go back to the original payment method in 5-7 business days.
Items are covered by a 12-month warranty against defects. We send a free replacement once you share a photo of the defect.
Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and express takes 1-2 business days. A tracking email is sent when your order ships.
If tracking shows no movement for 7 days, we reissue the order or refund it in full. Please contact us within 30 days of the ship date.
If tracking says delivered but nothing arrived, check with neighbors and household members for 24 hours, then contact us and we will open a carrier investigation.
Confirmed duplicate charges are reversed within 3-5 business days. A pending authorization drops off automatically within 5 days.
You can cancel any time under Settings > Billing. Access continues until the end of the paid period.
Use Forgot password on the sign-in page. The reset link expires after 60 minutes.
Changing the email on an account requires a verification code sent to the current email address.
Update to the latest app version and restart. If the problem continues, send your device model and OS version so engineering can investigate.
If the website shows an error, clear your browser cache and try again in a private window. If it persists, send us the page link and a screenshot.
